name: Aino (Cornils) Vonge Corry
bio:
Metadeveloper can help you with facilitation of meetings in general and retrospectives for agile development in particular. I also have expertise in facilitating OKR meetings,  design sprint facilitation, architecture health workshops, mob programming sessions and executive strategy summits.

I also offer teaching in Science Teaching,  Retrospective Facilitation, The Product Owner Role, The Scrum Master 
Role, Design patterns, UML, software architecture or OOA&D.

Presentations include areas such as Retrospective Facilitation, Teaching and learning in general, How to do Presentations, Science Teaching, Functional Design Patterns, OO Design Patterns, and a humorous party presentation on Dating Patterns :-).
